name: photo-scan
description: Convert phone photographs of documents into clean, perspective-corrected multi-page scanned PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn document photos into scanned PDFs
interface.longDescription: Clean photographed documents, correct page perspective, and combine ordered photos into a PDF using a bundled Python scanner. Requires a host that can execute Python and access uploaded files.
defaultPrompt: Turn these phone photos into a clean scanned PDF.
Combine these document photos into a black-and-white PDF.
